statusContract.PASS: The bounded stage has a deterministic local or remote automated check.
statusContract.PARTIAL: A bounded check exists, but the stage still has an explicit acceptance gap.
statusContract.NOT_READY: The required implementation or test entry point is not delivered.
statusContract.DEFERRED: The stage is deliberately reserved for an external, fixed-hardware, or long-run plan.
